newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota says in talks over S.Africa car maker stake.
newsitem.headline: Toyota says in talks over S.Africa car maker stake.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said on Monday that it is negotiating with South Africa's Johnnies Industrial Corp Ltd (Johnnic) over Toyota's possible purchase of part of Johnnic's stake in Toyota South Africa Ltd.
Toyota currently provides technology to Toyota SA, but has no equity relationship with the South African car maker.
"We are in negotiations. We think we will be able to clarify the result of the negotiations in the near future," a Toyota spokesman said without elaborating.
Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Monday that Toyota is negotiating with Johnnic over the acquisition of a 21.4 percent stake in Toyota South Africa.
Johnnic is the second largest shareholder in Toyota South Africa, which is the largest car maker in that country, the paper said.
